nodes.title: Fetch exact selections with singular provenance
nodes.summary: Deliver public fetch(selection, start=, end=) and fetch_by_provider(selection, start=, end=) as one coherent re-parameterisation of the existing observation engine, retaining every legacy public name for m9 and leaving the unresolved raw= and on_issue= controls and RawMode fate entirely to m5. Convert each selection's sorted (provider_id, station_id, product_id) series into exact provider-scoped observation requests without expanding a sparse selection into the Cartesian product produced by the current separate stations/products request shape; preserve ADR-0016 wall-clock, closed-endpoint parsing and refusal of zone-carrying endpoints, the fixed five-column observation data frame, and the existing four-member ObservationResult (observation frame/data, provenance, issues, raw). fetch must validate the RivRetrieve selection and reject a reason-carrying empty selection and a multi-provider selection before provider lookup can reach registry._ProviderHandle.observations, driver.drive, or the first source-call seam ProviderStages.fetch; the empty error must carry the selection's _EmptyReason, while the mixed-provider error must deterministically name every provider and direct the caller to fetch_by_provider. fetch_by_provider must partition only by provider and return exactly one ObservationResult per selected provider, with each result's singular ObservationProvenance.provider_id, license, citation, request series, and RawPayload.provider_id confined to that provider; it must never merge provider-free observation frames. Acceptance evidence uses a recording fake ProviderStages.fetch to prove zero stage/source calls for both empty and mixed-provider fetch failures, including preservation of a concrete reason returned by find; proves a usgs_nwis/ca_eccc mixed selection names both providers and points to fetch_by_provider; proves sparse series routing makes calls only for selected station-product pairs; proves fetch_by_provider returns one four-member result per provider with matching singular provenance and no provider_id observation column; proves the legacy observation API still passes its existing engine and ADR-0016 tests; and updates tests/test_package.py's exact-public-name assertion to add only fetch and fetch_by_provider alongside all current names, explicitly not adding m7's map name or deleting any m9-owned legacy name.
